tests.test: Hand-computed WCAG contrast, light pressed: #b3122a on white+20% tint (bg ~ rgb(240,208,212)) = 4.82:1 (was 4.46 at 24%). Not re-run in browser.
Other states untouched: resting 6.06+, hover (12% tint) 5.59, busy 5.46, dark pressed 5.94 (dark rule not changed).
Pressed still distinct: tint 20% vs resting 0% vs hover 12%, plus transform scale 0.95 unchanged.

commands_run.command: none beyond edit (contrast computed by hand)

design_decisions.decision: Lowered tint alpha to 0.20 instead of darkening --danger, because --danger is shared by error areas and resting text whose passing values would shift.

implementation.self_critique: Contrast computed manually, not re-measured in browser; margin 4.82 vs 4.5 is comfortable. Visual gap between hover (0.12) and pressed (0.20) is smaller than before but scale transform still differs.
